fusions.name: Spurred Circle
fusions.desc: Wheels the lash around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Riding Lash
fusions.desc: You charge up to 6 tiles to an enemy and lash it for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Rein
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Winded
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 20 stamina. Once every 20 seconds.
